United Nations membership status.descriptionShort: Membership is defined along current countries and their borders.
United Nations membership status.descriptionProcessing: The list of current UN members has been expanded with non-member entities we can map but are not included in the original list. Added entities include Taiwan, Palestine and Kosovo, among others.
